import pandas as pd

def clean(df):
    # Remove exact duplicate rows
    df = df.drop_duplicates().reset_index(drop=True)
    
    # Clean Price: remove $ and commas, convert to float
    df['Price'] = df['Price'].astype(str).str.replace('$', '', regex=False).str.replace(',', '', regex=False).astype(float)
    
    # Clean Category: strip whitespace and standardize case
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Map known mislabeled categories to correct ones
    category_mapping = {
        'Electrials': 'Electricals',
        'Accesosries': 'Accessories',
        'Ofifce Supplies': 'Office Supplies',
        'ELECTRONICS': 'Electronics',
        'OFTICE SUPPLIES': 'Office Supplies',
        'OUTDOOR SUPPLIES': 'Outdoor Supplies',
        'oFFICE sUPPLIES': 'Office Supplies',
        'oUTDOOR sUPPLIES': 'Outdoor Supplies',
        'outdoor supplies': 'Outdoor Supplies',
        'FURNITURE': 'Furniture',
        'Electronics ': 'Electronics',
        '  Electronics ': 'Electronics',
        '  Outdoor Supplies ': 'Outdoor Supplies',
        ' Furniture': 'Furniture'
    }
    df['Category'] = df['Category'].replace(category_mapping)
    
    # Clean Region: strip whitespace and standardize case
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].astype(str).str.strip().str.title()
    
    # Map known mislabeled regions
    region_mapping = {
        'Weest': 'West',
        'Suotheast': 'Southeast',
        'Southh': 'South',
        'Souuth': 'South',
        'Nort': 'North',
        'orth': 'North',
        'EAST': 'East',
        'NORTHEAST': 'Northeast',
        'nORTHEAST': 'Northeast',
        'southeast': 'Southeast',
        'sOUTHEAST': 'Southeast',
        ' Northeast': 'Northeast',
        ' Southeast': 'Southeast',
        'West ': 'West'
    }
    df['Region'] = df['Region'].replace(region_mapping)
    
    # Filter only allowed categories and regions
    allowed_categories = ['Electronics', 'Electricals', 'Accessories', 'Furniture', 'Office Supplies', 'Outdoor Supplies']
    allowed_regions = ['North', 'South', 'East', 'West', 'Northeast', 'Southeast']
    df = df[df['Category'].isin(allowed_categories)]
    df = df[df['Region'].isin(allowed_regions)]
    
    return df

def answer(df):
    # Filter for East region
    east_df = df[df['Region'] == 'East']

    counts = east_df['Category'].value_counts()
